name: agent-neuron
description: Experimental agent graph: a specification for neurons (wrappers around any program) wired by a JSON network file, its conformance fixtures, and the Rust engine that runs it.

scripts.conform: npm run -s engine:build && rust-engine/target/release/neuron-engine conform spec/fixtures && rust-engine/target/release/neuron-engine conform spec/probes
scripts.check: npm run -s engine:fmt && npm run -s engine:clippy && npm run -s engine:test && npm run -s conform
scripts.demo:human: npm run -s engine:build && rust-engine/target/release/neuron-engine run examples/human/human.network.json --inputs examples/human/human.inputs.jsonl
